manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Observe the velocity and gravity vectors on a tossed ball as it rises, pauses at the top, and falls back down.
manifest.description: A vertical height scale shows a ball moving upward and downward. A blue motion vector shortens and disappears at the peak, while a dashed gravity vector remains constantly pointed downward.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
